body: thanks for reporting @rkapsi ... sounds like a bug to me
@Scottmitch @rkapsi I wonder what you think is the better option here. Throw an exception when calling add or just remove it directly after it is added automatically ? I guess 1) is better. WDYT ?
I'd go with Exception as well.
@Scottmitch sounds good to you as well ?
Exception should be fine (static exception?), hopefully we have been diligent in handling exceptions in cases where ReferenceCounted things are added to the pipeline :sweat_smile:
@Scottmitch I think non static exception is better as I not expect this to be thrown often and it will be better to have some context

Motivation:

ChannelPipeline will happily add a handler to a closed Channel's pipeline and will call handlerAdded(...) but will not call handlerRemoved(...).

Modifications:

Check if pipeline was destroyed and if so not add the handler at all but propergate an exception.
